browserTests.gpuFixture: Five lighting/weather material conditions; dry/wet/hold/rewind; non-emissive rain and point-light response; constant resource count. ISOLATED fixture.

budgets.fogQuadrature: Up to eight samples per existing pocket, only with nonzero local density. Additional fragment ALU requires hardware measurement.
budgets.reflectionRefresh: Existing double-buffer cube pass additionally recaptures on environment-map identity change, including paused lighting changes. No continuously varying-intensity trigger.

limitations: Non-road dampness uses rain plus recorded mean track water, not local off-track water, roof occlusion or fabric saturation.
Rain/spray lighting uses bounded single-scattering-style gains; no volumetric shadow or calibrated photometric claim.
Pure overcast is covered by the isolated material fixture; no invented pure-overcast session mode or complete normal-game overcast lap is claimed.
Actual full-lap images/videos and all-reference discrepancies still need inspection on the published revision.
Physical Windows target-hardware, controller/wheel, VRAM and frame-time acceptance remain open.
